changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 6 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6310-designer-formula-key-retired.md`

- names `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Not touched: `designer.field.formula` (`'Formula (CEL)'`) in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, a different and live key belonging to metadata-admin's `ObjectFieldInspector` — the surface that still authors formula expressions.

### `.changeset/7125-dashboard-empty-state-keys-retired.md`

- names `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Not touched: `table.noRows` (`'No rows to display'`) and `engine.form.noRows` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, read at `widgets.tsx`) — two different, same-named keys in different namespaces. Nor the comments in `WidgetEmptyState.tsx`, `DatasetWidget.tsx`, `ObjectDataTable.tsx` and `PivotTable.tsx` that record WHY three widgets with three strings became one shared empty state; the packs' own comment keeps that rationale and now names the retirement instead of a row that is gone.

### `.changeset/7772-page-block-kanban-group-by-control.md`

- names `previews/__tests__/block-config.test.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/__tests__/block-config.test.ts` — edited by this change

  > Run against the node those four controls produced, `ObjectKanbanSchema.safeParse` reported **two** issues, not one: `groupBy` "expected string, received undefined", and `groupField` carrying the retirement guidance verbatim. So this panel could not author a valid `object-kanban` node however it was filled in, and the board it produced grouped nothing with no diagnostic on any face. Both halves are now pinned against the schema itself rather than against a spelling, in `previews/__tests__/block-config.test.ts` — `scripts/check-designer-field-key-parity.mjs` judges `PAYLOAD_SHAPES` and does not read `BLOCK_CONFIG`, so nothing mechanical was watching this table.

### `.changeset/8278-page-tabs-item-value.md`

- names `block-config.test.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/__tests__/block-config.test.ts` — edited by this change

  > - `ComponentPropsMap['page:tabs'].safeParse` returns `success: false` with `unrecognized_keys` naming `key` at `items.0` — and 17.3.0's own message now spells the remedy out, "Did you mean `key` -> `value`?"; - `PageTabsRenderer` builds `itemsWithValue` from `it.value` and reads `it.key` nowhere, so the tab falls back to the index-derived `tab-IDX`; - `PageTabsProps.items[].value` is a real, declared schema member, which this repo's own `block-config.test.ts` already stated in prose.

- names `block-config.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/block-config.ts` — edited by this change

  > The control is renamed to `value` on the producer side — AGENTS.md #0.1 and the rule stated in `block-config.ts`'s own file header ("keep each field `name` aligned with the property name the corresponding renderer reads"). Teaching the renderer a second spelling would have been the lenient-fallback shape that rule forbids. The field `name` is the last segment of the i18n key, so both locale tables move with it in this one commit and the retired key leaves both, the objectui#3829 / objectui#5212 pattern.

### `.changeset/8279-definition-list-term-description.md`

- names `block-config.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/block-config.ts` — edited by this change

  > The controls are renamed to `term` / `description` — the producer side, per AGENTS.md #0.1 and the rule stated in `block-config.ts`'s own file header ("keep each field `name` aligned with the property name the corresponding renderer reads"). Two of the three faces already agreed: the block's registry declaration names `items` as "Term/description pairs `[{ term, description }]`". The designer was the outlier, so moving the renderer instead would have put it at odds with its own declaration.

### `.changeset/8632-malformed-picklist-option-loud.md`

- names `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Two new strings land in the designer's own `en` / `zh` tables — the metadata-admin console owns its strings in `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` and is deliberately outside the ten locale packs (`packages/i18n/README.md`, "Scope — the `engine.*` carve-out").

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `0961d5e20` (merge-base with origin/main): 6 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1374 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (1949 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36081222684)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `0fd05e1489f21b52981f5384e5377895441e52f9`

Merge-base `3335767b4` (matches the PR's stated base); one commit `0fd05e1` on the branch; 7 files, +78/-44 (REST file list agrees with `git diff`). PR is still `draft: true`.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Panel and i18n rows gone.** `BLOCK_CONFIG['ai:input']` is deleted from `previews/block-config.ts` (head key count 20, base 21). `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` loses exactly 6 rows: `field.ai:input.agentName`, `placeholder.ai:input.agentName`, `field.ai:input.placeholder` in en (base :733-:735) and zh (base :2667-:2669). `git grep -n "ai:input" refs/review/pr-10444` on the head tree finds no remaining reader of those keys: the only hits outside this PR's own comments/changeset are `packages/components/src/renderers/placeholders.tsx:114` (PROTOCOL_COMPONENTS, unchanged, as ruled), `packages/cli/src/utils/known-schema-types.ts:45,:348` (the placeholder record, unchanged), `.github/prompts/component.prompt.md:226` (lists it under Protocol Placeholders, guarded by `check-prompt-component-keys.mjs`, not a panel claim), `scripts/__tests__/check-prompt-component-keys.test.ts` (fixture strings), and `packages/app-shell/CHANGELOG.md:12390` (release history). No other locale pack, no `content/**`, `skills/**` or `docs/**` hit (`git grep -i -E "ai:input|agent ?name"` over those dirs: only ADR-0057's unrelated `resolveDefaultAgentName`). The card said four entries; six rows is the true count and the PR states it.

- **Rewritten test reads the palette, and the palette is the picker's list.** `block-config.test.ts:333-335` now builds `offered = new Set(TYPES_BY_CATEGORY.flatMap(g => g.types))` and asserts `Object.keys(BLOCK_CONFIG).filter(t => !offered.has(t))` is `[]`. `block-types.ts:267-272` builds `TYPES_BY_CATEGORY` by iterating `Object.entries(BLOCK_TYPE_META)` alone, so `offered` is exactly the 33 `BLOCK_TYPE_META` keys. The claim "the list the page canvas's picker renders" verifies: `PageBlockCanvas.tsx:893-911` `AddBlockButton` returns `TYPES_BY_CATEGORY` unfiltered when no search text, and `canvas-display-meta.test.tsx:203` already pins "TYPES_BY_CATEGORY is what the Add-block picker iterates". Ruling condition (fail for a panel on a block neither in the palette nor in `BLOCK_TYPE_META`) is met and is actually stricter: any `BLOCK_CONFIG` key outside `BLOCK_TYPE_META` fails, including a `PALETTE_EXCLUSIONS` block with a panel (the ai:chat_window shape). False-fail on a legitimate palette panel is impossible by construction (palette == BLOCK_TYPE_META == TYPES_BY_CATEGORY); `comm -23 cfg-keys meta-keys` on head is empty, on base it prints exactly `ai:input`. Ablation reasoning is deterministic: re-adding the panel makes `orphanPanels == ['ai:input']`, and independently trips the 8216 coverage case ("every block either resolves to an oracle or carries an exemption") and the i18n count pins. `specNames` remains used at :252-:277, so no unused-local fallout. The `ai:input` entry is also dropped from the "exposes a configurable panel" list at :44.

- **8216 parity exemption row.** The `ai:input` EXEMPT row is deleted (head `EXEMPT` has 2 rows, both `card: 'objectui#8281'`). Correct rather than merely permitted: `block-config-schema-parity-8216.test.ts:324-327` asserts `BLOCK_CONFIG[type]` is defined for every exemption, so the row had to go with the panel. The remaining `element:definition-list` (carrying objectui#8279 in its reason) and `element:repeater` rows are untouched; the doc comment's edit from "the two blocks with their own separate defects" to "a block with its own separate defect" is true of the surviving rows. The vacuity guard at :334 (`judged > EXEMPT.length * 3`) only loosens (6 vs 9). objectui#8281's body still says "three blocks"; the ruling put this row's removal here and told 8281's claimant to re-read, so that is expected, not a defect.

- **PageBlockInspector.i18n.test.tsx retarget.** The zh-CN prose-hint case now renders `pageDraft('element:button')` and asserts `lucide 图标名` present / `lucide icon name` absent plus `expectNoRawKeyPlaceholders()`. Verified: `block-config.ts:370` gives `element:button.icon` the keyed placeholder `engine.inspector.pageBlock.placeholder.element:button.icon`, resolved at `i18n.ts:670` (en `lucide icon name`) and `:2605` (zh `lucide 图标名`); `element:button` has exactly one such text field, so `getByPlaceholderText` cannot hit duplicates. The PR's claim that no other case asserts that hint holds (other `element:button` renders at :294/:303/:415/:421 assert the JSON literal and parse error; the `lucide 图标名` assertion at :345 is for `record:alert`). Nothing is silently dropped: the removed assertion pinned a hint whose key no longer exists. Nit: the new `it` name says "prose sites no other case here renders" while other cases do render element:button (they just do not assert the hint); the inline comment is precise, the name slightly overstates.

- **block-config-i18n.test.ts counts.** Mechanically right. `grep -c "placeholder: {"` on head `block-config.ts` = 17, `placeholder: { key:` = 6, `placeholder: { literal:` = 11; base = 18/7/11. The "ALL SIX" EXPECTED table lists exactly the 6 keyed placeholders that exist at head (object-metric.icon, element:text.content, element:button.icon, record:details.sections.name, record:alert.icon, record:quick_actions.actionNames). `families.placeholder` 7 to 6 is consistent. The `block-config.ts` header edit is true: the old line ("18 placeholders, 8 prose, 10 VALUES") was already wrong on base (real split 7/11), and the replacement points at `previews/__tests__/block-config-i18n.test.ts`, which is where the "collects all 17 placeholders" pin lives (:410-:412). No other test pins a `BLOCK_CONFIG` entry count (`git grep -E "keys\(BLOCK_CONFIG\)\.length"` in metadata-admin: none).

- **Clause-②: no is right.** `BLOCK_CONFIG` is not exported from `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` (no `block-config` mention, no `export * from` there or in `views/metadata-admin/index.ts`); the only importers are 8 files inside `views/metadata-admin` (`git grep -l "block-config'"`). `package.json` exports map is `.` to `dist/index.js` and `./styles.css` only. Removing a key from a non-published `Record` widens or narrows no published schema, export or accept set; `PROTOCOL_COMPONENTS` and `known-schema-types.ts` are unchanged.

### ② Semver level

`'@object-ui/app-shell': patch` is right. `@object-ui/app-shell` is in the 40-package `fixed` group (`.changeset/config.json`), so a declaration is required; `check-changeset-presence.mjs` header says even an empty frontmatter counts, and AGENTS.md §版本号策略 (:257-:263) forbids only `major` and reserves `minor` for objectui's own breaking changes. Nothing published breaks here, and the "Changeset Bump Policy" gate is the no-major script alone (`changeset-guard.yml:110-122`), completed success. Prose checked: "never offered" holds on the evidence reachable (the commit that introduced the panel, `5e8965c` / #1493, added it to `block-config.ts` only; `block-types.ts` at that commit has 0 `ai:input` occurrences via the contents API, and head has none; local history is shallow at 65 commits so intermediate states were not exhaustively walked). "Shows that node's keys in the inspector's generic Advanced section" holds: `PageBlockInspector.tsx:490-495` computes `advancedKeys = Object.keys(blockProps)` minus curated names (now none for `ai:input`) minus `STRUCTURAL_PROP_KEYS` (`children`, `body` only, :254), rendered at :790-:795 under `engine.inspector.pageBlock.advanced`. "Three English and three Chinese labels" is 3 keys per locale (two field labels plus one placeholder hint; "labels" is loose but the count is right).
